jobs.title: Research Data Scientist
jobs.description: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 Explore your future career 🔭 We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML). Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion. Some of the questions you might explore : - How is the freelancing market evolving in time ? What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions? - What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? - How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior? Key responsibilities ✨ Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency. Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation

jobs.title: Business / Data Analyst (F/H/X) - CDI
jobs.description: 📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE Rattaché(e) au département Sourcing Groupe, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les directeurs commerciaux de Brandsplace et leurs responsables d'affaires pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans à court, moyen et long terme, en organisant le suivi des performances et en facilitant l'accès aux données. Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data de Brandsplace et serez rattaché(e) au responsable des données commerciales Groupe. Votre champ d'action couvrira tous les secteurs d'activité de Brandsplace, tels que le commerce, la logistique, le marketing ou la gestion des relations clients. 🎯 MISSIONS Construire des outils de suivi de la performance : chiffre d’affaires, marge et indicateurs clés de performance (KPI). Réaliser les reportings et analyses hebdomadaires et mensuels des résultats commerciaux. Calculer les bonus sur l’ensemble du périmètre Brandsplace. Collaborer étroitement avec les Business Managers et les Directeurs Commerciaux afin de répondre à leurs besoins en matière de données. Développer des prévisions commerciales et mettre en place les processus et outils associés. Concevoir des tableaux de bord avancés sur MicroStrategy afin d’automatiser les processus de reporting. Formuler et demander des requêtes SQL complexes pour répondre aux problématiques et besoins métiers. 👉 PRÉ REQUIS Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans un environnement exigeant en matière de reporting, avec notamment la création et la gestion de modèles sur Google Sheets ou Excel. Une connaissance de l’activité Marketplace est un plus. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données provenant de sources multiples, y compris lorsqu’elles sont complexes, et disposez d’excellentes capacités de modélisation. Une expérience préalable en SQL n’est pas obligatoire, mais constitue un réel atout. Vous avez une bonne compréhension des différents métiers de la VP et de leurs enjeux commerciaux. Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, indispensable pour le poste.

jobs.description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Role As a Senior Product Data Analyst , you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions. Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with meaningful autonomy and close cross-functional partnership. What You'll Do in 12 Months Make the marketplace easier to discover and more relevant: Study how customers browse chefs, meals, cuisines, dietary options, and price points. Analyze the relationship between local assortment, variety, personalization, and ordering behavior. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . At Reddit, machine learning sits at the heart of how millions of people discover, connect, and engage with the world’s largest collection of human conversations. From powering personalized recommendations and search to optimizing advertising systems and marketplace dynamics, our ML engineers tackle some of the most interesting and impactful problems in large-scale applied machine learning. We hire Machine Learning Engineers across both our Consumer and Ads organizations, giving you the opportunity to work on a wide range of high-impact problems across the Reddit ecosystem. We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers who are excited to build systems end-to-end, from research and modeling to production deployment, — and who want to help shape the future of discovery, relevance, and monetization at Reddit. If you love working on complex, real-world ML problems at massive scale, this role is for you. What You’ll Work On As a Machine Learning Engineer at Reddit, you will design and build production ML systems that power core experiences across the platform, including: Personalized recommendations, search, and ranking systems that help users discover the most relevant content and communities Intelligent advertising systems including ranking, bidding, measurement, and optimization Content, Advertisers, and User understanding, from building foundational content/user representations to deriving insightful signals Large-scale machine learning pipelines, model serving infrastructure, and real-time decision systems Applied AI and
